title: Swarm wave 8: live monitor a11y snapshot + Wayland data-device system clipboard

swarm.convention: GY-WAVE2-SWARM (concurrent agents, exclusive crate ownership, frozen interface contract, central integration gate)

assignments.J1: goya-zcode: src/a11y.rs — scene-rect capture once at startup (fixed-size window), DIG build from live state (title/status Label nodes, rows with live text and empty rows omitted, composer as Textbox with placeholder label + focused mirror + scene hit region, quit Button with press), MonitorA11y::republish on the dirty flag, --a11y-dump mode, 4 new tests
assignments.J2: goya-wayland: wl_data_device_manager v1 bound; set_clipboard_text (wl_data_source, text/plain offers, in-memory payload, chunked char-boundary-safe sends), request_clipboard_text -> PlatformEvent::ClipboardText(Option<String>) (one outstanding request; selection change cancels), pure ClipboardState machine (mime negotiation, request phases, chunked serving) with 10 new tests

integration_findings: Upstream gap documented by J1: A11yTree has no public per-node mutator, so live_text cannot be patched into a projected tree from outside goya-a11y; MonitorA11y publishes the structural tree plus an AT-facing node snapshot until goya-a11y exposes get_mut.

Incremental a11y updates (run_with_updates) are behind the atspi-gtk feature (GTK/AT-SPI bridge, not wired here by contract); headless path is full-tree publish per dirty flag — documented in module docs.
gate fixes: formatting pass only; no semantic integration fixes needed (zero GATE markers).

verification.zcode_monitor_headless: all 18 checks PASS (incl. a11y snapshot composer/rows/quit + republish-on-change)
verification.zcode_monitor_a11y_dump_live: live dump shows composer as role=TextInput name='type here…' states=[enabled,editable,focusable] actions=[set_value,focus]
verification.zcode_monitor_stdin_dump_live: link Connecting->Up, subscribed to live session

scope_honesty.a11y: DIG/dump verified headless and live; real screen-reader (Orca) operation remains operator-verified territory. Incremental AT-SPI updates need the gtk feature bridge (upstream).
scope_honesty.clipboard: Protocol plumbing unit-tested; live compositor copy/paste interop is operator-verified territory. The monitor's clipboard ring is still in-monitor; backing it with these host calls is goya-zcode work deferred to a next wave (documented in goya-wayland crate docs).

notes: Closes the goya-clipboard 'deferred to GY-WAYLAND-001 follow-through' system-clipboard gap at the protocol level.
Doctests excluded per known host rustdoc LLVM issue (README).
kaptaind auto-committed agent work incrementally (v2.13.x); gate verified the final tree via all workspace gates.
